item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Six Flags closes nine roller coasters after fatal Georgia fall
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Six Flags temporarily shut down nine similar North American coasters after a man fell to his death from the Goliath ride at Six Flags Over Georgia. The closures put amusement-park safety, manufacturer review and liability risk in the spotlight. [1] [2]

Sources: [1] [2]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [3]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [4]

item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: TxDOT proposes diverging-diamond interchange at Gattis School Road and SH 130

item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

Sources: [7]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Taylor approves 664-acre data-center campus with on-site power
item.description:

Section: 🇮🇳 India News

item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News
